summary.text: Chris Jeter is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 88 who has represented the district since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was appointed to the seat in 2020.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Stephanie Yocum, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Jeter was appointed to the vacant District 88 seat by Republican precinct committeemen on August 19, 2020, and took office on August 26, 2020, succeeding Brian Bosma.
